text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka-sho.
The paddock was wrapped in a restless murmur.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Today...
I'll catch up to Bourbon-san—no!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't Rice Shower feel... somehow different
after getting through this summer?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Bourbon made comments
viewing them as a rival during the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Just maybe...
this could really happen!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but still,
whenever I see Mihono Bourbon, man!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the distance is a bit concerning,
but they did say they trained hard on the uphill slope!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Detecting an immense level of 'pressure'
emanating from Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Also... I can visually detect
significant growth from Tannhauser-san as well.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I've determined that flawless mission execution is required,
without letting down our guard for a single second.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will not yield the Kikuka-sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, Bourbon-san and Rice-san
are looking totally dialed in~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san in particular
looks like she's in waaaay great shape...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Indeed, we must tackle this with full spirit!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, feeling a hundred times more energetic, victory is ours!
Ei, ei, mun!
